notes: Milestone 87: two zero-gradient forgeries (stale, coast) of a segment's last q of 20 steps over 1,280 runs (4 optimisers x 4 schedules x 80 seeds; about 6 min on 4 CPUs). The weight-only referee is fooled (Adam coast q=2 caught in at most 1.3%); the weight-or-moment referee catches q=1 in 80-100% and q=2 in at least 95.4%, with no honest conviction. 7 of 9 pre-registered predictions held; E5 and E7 failed in one cell each (Adam 4e-3 warmcos). Post hoc: thresholds zoned by 5 segments catch q=1 in 98.6-100% at a 0.9-1.8% honest arbiter load.
